entities.name: Experimental type 1 diabetes
observations: Streptozotocin-induced diabetes in rats is associated with increased hippocampal kynurenic acid content.

entities.name: Kynurenic acid
observations: Hippocampal KYNA reached 220% of control in untreated streptozotocin-diabetic rats after 5 weeks, approximately a 120% increase.
Hippocampal KYNA remained elevated at 170% of control in insulin-treated diabetic rats, approximately a 70% increase.

entities.name: PMID:25443746
observations: Experimental diabetes mellitus type 1 increased hippocampal KYNA selectively in rats; untreated diabetic animals had 220% of control and insulin-treated animals had 170% of control after 5 weeks.
Hippocampal KAT II activity was 126% of control, while KAT I was unchanged.

entities.name: PMID:31737685
observations: In streptozotocin-induced type 1 diabetic rats, hippocampal KYNA was increased in untreated and insulin-treated animals; four weeks of losartan normalized KYNA only with concomitant insulin.
Source: Journal of Diabetes Research follow-up study.
